home_title: Property Asset: track properties, co-owners, income and expenses
hero_title: Every property, every owner, every cent. In one place.
hero_lede: Property Asset keeps your properties, ownership shares, rent, bills and documents organized, in any currency, and shares them with the people you own them with.

shot_dashboard: Dashboard with portfolio value, net income, income and expenses
features_title: Built for people who own property together
features_lede: Spreadsheets break the moment there's a second owner, a second currency or a second unit. Property Asset was built around all three.
f1_text: Houses, apartments, commercial space and land, with units, addresses, purchase price and current value.
f2_text: Co-owners with shares that add up to 100%, per-transaction splits, and a My share view of what's actually yours.
f3_text: Record each amount in the currency it was paid in. The exchange rate is stored with it, so reports never drift.
f4_text: Rent, mortgage and condo fees post on their own or wait for you to confirm them. Change an amount from any date.
f5_text: Portfolio value, income, expenses and net for any period, per property or in total, with CSV export.
f6_text: Leases, invoices and receipts attached to a property, a unit or a transaction. Scan paper with the camera.
f7_text: Owner, admin, editor and viewer roles, invite links and codes, and a history of key changes.
f8_text: Keep working without a connection. Changes sync when you're back, and nothing is lost if two people edit at once.

shot_transactions: Transactions list with income and expenses

privacy_1: No ads, no trackers, no third-party analytics.
privacy_2: Hosted in the European Union, encrypted in transit and at rest.
privacy_3: Each workspace is isolated: people see only what their role allows.
privacy_4: Optional Face ID lock, and the app switcher never shows your numbers.
privacy_5: Export everything, or delete your account, from the app at any time.
price_text: Property Asset 1.0 is free, with every feature on this page. If paid plans come later, you'll be told in advance and what you already have keeps working.
q_devices: Which devices does it run on?
a_devices: iPhone and iPad with iOS 18.1 or later, and Macs with Apple silicon. Your data syncs between them.
a_languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French, German, Italian, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian and Finnish. It follows your device's language, or you can choose one in the app.
q_partner: Can my partner or accountant see the numbers?
a_partner: Yes. Invite them to your workspace as an editor or a viewer. Viewers can see everything but change nothing.
a_offline: You can keep viewing and editing. Changes are saved on the device and sent when you're back online.
a_currencies: All major currencies. Rates come from the European Central Bank's reference rates and you can override any of them.
a_storage: With our hosting provider in the European Union. The details are in the Privacy Policy.
q_delete: How do I delete my account?
a_delete: In the app, open the Workspace tab and tap Delete Account. You can export your data first with Export Data. See Support for more.
support_lede: Something not working, or a question about your data? We're happy to help.
contact_reply: We reply within two business days. Please include your app version (Workspace tab, at the bottom).
contact_soon: A support email address will be listed here when the app launches.
s_code_q: I didn't get the verification code
s_code_a: Check your spam or junk folder. Codes expire after a while: tap Resend code on the verification screen to get a new one.
s_password_a: On the Sign In screen, tap Forgot password? and enter your email address. We'll email you a 6-digit code: enter it with your new password and you're signed in.
s_invite_q: How do I invite someone to my workspace?
s_invite_a: Open the Workspace tab and tap Invite Member to send an email invitation, or create an invite link or code. Owners and admins can change roles, and revoke or resend invitations under Invitations & Codes.
s_waiting_q: Why is an amount waiting for confirmation?
s_waiting_a: Recurring items set to confirm first wait until you check the amount. Confirm them on the Transactions tab. Waiting items aren't included in reports until they're confirmed.
s_conflict_q: I edited something offline and see a conflict
s_conflict_a: Someone else changed the same item before your change was sent. Open Workspace → Sync and choose which version to keep.
s_deleted_a: Deleted properties, transactions and documents stay in Workspace → Recently Deleted for 30 days. Owners and admins can restore them from there.
s_export_q: How do I export my data?
s_export_a: The Dashboard's share button exports the report as CSV. Workspace → Export Data creates a ZIP file with spreadsheets of properties, transactions, recurring items and members, plus every uploaded document.
s_account_q: How do I delete my account?
s_account_a: Go to Workspace → Delete Account. If you own a workspace other people use, transfer ownership first: open the workspace, go to Members and choose Transfer Ownership. Details are in the Privacy Policy.
s_language_q: How do I change the app's language?
s_language_a: Open Workspace → Language and choose a language, or keep the device's. Close the app and open it again to use it.
